# Batobus

> > Batobus is Paris's hop-on-hop-off river shuttle service operating along the Seine, connecting major landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Notre-Dame, and Musée d'Orsay.

Since 1989, Batobus has provided eco-friendly river transport across Paris with hybrid propulsion boats, Green Globe certification, and multiple pass options. The service features nine stations along the Seine with audio guides and family-friendly activities.

## Key Topics

- Batobus river shuttle

## Batobus Stations & Stops

- [Station Louvre | Batobus](https://www.batobus.com/fr/louvre): Louvre station stop for Musée du Louvre and Tuileries Garden access
- [Stazione Hôtel de Ville | Batobus](https://www.batobus.com/it/hotel-de-ville): Hôtel de Ville station stop serving Marais, Centre Pompidou, Place Vosges
- [Stazione Place de la Concorde | Batobus](https://www.batobus.com/it/place-de-la-concorde): Place de la Concorde stop near Champs-Élysées and Arc de Triomphe
- [Jardin des Plantes Station | Batobus](https://www.batobus.com/de/jardin-des-plantes): Jardin des Plantes stop near Panthéon and Natural History Museum
- [Estación Invalides | Batobus](https://www.batobus.com/es/invalides): Invalides station: Napoleon's tomb, Rodin Museum, Pont Alexandre III
- [Estación Jardin des Plantes | Batobus](https://www.batobus.com/es/jardin-des-plantes): Jardin des Plantes stop: Panthéon, Arab Institute, Mode & Design
